title: Know Thyself, Know Thy User: Intrinsic Dual-Perspective Reasoning for Role-Playing LLMs
claim: A model embeds dual-perspective reasoning inside its architecture through four coordinated modules that process inputs, attend, reason, and route.
layout: 4 numbered panels, left-to-right, colored boxes with circled step numbers
description: Four rounded panels sit side by side, each marked with a red numbered circle. Panel 1, Input Processing Pipeline, stacks a raw input box with four colored extraction boxes (role context, user intent, instruction detection, context segmentation). Its output splits into blue 'Self' and orange 'Other' arrows. Panel 2, Dual-Stream Axial Attention, is the visual centre. A purple position-encoding banner sits above a large blue 'Know Thyself' block with a role consistency matrix. Next to it is an orange 'Know Thy User' block with an intent-flow zigzag. Both feed a learned adaptive fusion node below. Panel 3, Bipolar Reasoning, splits Input into a green fast pathway and a purple slow pathway. These merge through a yellow gate into a weighted output. Panel 4, Self-Awareness MoE, shows a central router linked to four colored expert boxes (Personality, Knowledge, Emotional, Capability), with a colored bar and a load-balance loss box underneath.
caption: KSKT Architecture Overview. Our approach processes role-playing dialogues through four key components: (1) Input Processing
abstract: As role-playing Large Language Models (LLMs) become central to personalized AI, they face a fundamental challenge: balancing character authenticity with user satisfaction. Prior dual-process and dual-perspective approaches address this through prompt-level conditioning, auxiliary modules, or inference-time reflection---realizing duality externally rather than within the core attention mechanism. We introduce the KnowSelf-KnowOther Transformer (KSKT), which embeds dual-perspective reasoning directly into the generation process via dual-stream factorized attention that processes self-understanding and other-understanding through separate streams. This intrinsic integration enables token-level dynamic balance rather than post-hoc reconciliation. On CharacterBench, KSKT achieves 6.2% overall improvement over Qwen3-4B-Thinking. On SOTOPIA, KSKT improves Relationship by 19.3% over the base model---the dimension requiring explicit self-other coordination. These results establish intrinsic dual-perspective reasoning as an effective architectural principle for role-playing systems.
